title: Penthouses.
officialText:
Enclosed walls of penthouses shall comply with the requirements for exterior walls as per Tables 601 and
602 for the construction class of the building on which they are erected. Roofs of penthouses shall comply with the
requirements for roof construction of Table 601 and Chapter 15 of this code.
